title: Motion Picture Licence 2027
description:
Procurement of a special licence for the public performance of motion pictures.
 The licence is required to enable the lawful screening of films or TV programmes in connection with the Planning Inspectorate's operational activities.
 The service is supplied as a single annual licence renewal by the rights holder, covering the agreed period and usage rights.

title: Maintenance of Chemagic Star / Starlet Machines
description: Maintenance, servicing and verification of specialised Hamilton robotic laboratory systems (AWGMS). The equipment forms a critical part of genomic testing pathways, automating liquid handling, nucleic acid extraction and sequencing preparation processes. These systems improve throughput, reduce manual handling, improve testing accuracy and support reduced turnaround times for patient samples.
